# --no-git: an unversioned base. Inside a repository the base is excluded from
# the host's git status; committing commands are file operations with no git
# invocation at all.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

mkdir host
cd host
exec git init -q

exec akb init scratch --no-git
stdout '^Initialized KB "scratch" at .*/host/scratch$'
stdout '^kb: excluded scratch/ from host git tracking via \.git/info/exclude \(local to this clone; remove that line to undo\)$'
# An unversioned base resolves and records no commit identity.
! stdout 'commit identity'

# No nested repository, and the mode is written explicitly.
! exists scratch/.git
exists scratch/.agent-kb/.gitignore
grep '^name: scratch$' scratch/.agent-kb/akb.yaml
grep '^versioning: none$' scratch/.agent-kb/akb.yaml

# The host's exclude file carries the base, and the host's own ignore file is
# left to the host: it tracks nothing of an unversioned base.
grep '^scratch/$' .git/info/exclude
! exists .gitignore
exec git status --porcelain
! stdout .

cd scratch

exec akb status
stdout '^Name: scratch$'
stdout '^Versioning: none$'
! stdout '^Git:'

# A page round-trip: every committing command writes files only, so the
# commands work with no git binary on PATH and inside no repository.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml

stdin ../../note-input.md
exec bash -c 'p=$(command -v akb); PATH=${p%/*}; export PATH; akb write notes/plain.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=0$'
stdout '^Written to kb/notes/plain\.md$'
exists kb/notes/plain.md

stdin ../../append-input.md
exec bash -c 'p=$(command -v akb); PATH=${p%/*}; export PATH; akb append notes/plain.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=0$'
stdout '^Appended to kb/notes/plain\.md$'
grep '^Appended in a base that is not versioned\.$' kb/notes/plain.md

# --no-commit is a no-op in a base that never commits.
stdin ../../note-input.md
exec bash -c 'p=$(command -v akb); PATH=${p%/*}; export PATH; akb --no-commit write notes/no-commit.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=0$'
exists kb/notes/no-commit.md

exec bash -c 'p=$(command -v akb); PATH=${p%/*}; export PATH; akb delete notes/plain.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=0$'
stdout '^Deleted kb/notes/plain\.md$'
! exists kb/notes/plain.md

# The base stayed outside every repository.
! exists .git

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Unversioned note
summary: Note in a base that is not versioned
tags: versioning
---
A page written in a base that has no repository.

-- append-input.md --
Appended in a base that is not versioned.
